liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The performance of Not Fade Away is highlighted as great by the listener [14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition from space into China Cat Sunflower is described as phenomenal [14]
- **It Must Have Been the Roses** (1 review): The band turned weak vocals into a sweet melody for this song, surprising the listener [16]
- **Sunrise** (1 review): The reviewer notes that Sunrise is a pretty good song for Donna to perform [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-12-29.141740.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 191 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1977-12-29.holwein.audience.jfishman.108432.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: The first set is described as excellent, while the second set is rated absolutely amazing; The recording seems pretty raucous but is quite muddy, typical of a Dickpick source [12][18]
- **gd1977-12-29.137198.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 14 songs; 98 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [5]
- **gd1977-12-29.aud.92374.flac16**: audience recording; 9 songs; 68 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds punchy, which is considered quite good for an nth generation cassette [7]

## Around the show

- This audience recording completely blows away the Dicks Picks version of the same show [10]
- The reviewer calls it the greatest show they have ever attended, despite the recording not being stellar [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-12-29.141740.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Analog Soundboard > Cassette > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav… [1]
- **gd1977-12-29.holwein.audience.jfishman.108432.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Holwein; transferred by JR Fishman; source: Reinhardt Holwein Audience Reel > ???? > DAT > CDR > EAC Secure Mode > WAV > FLAC [4]
- **gd1977-12-29.137198.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat (48k) [5]. Also: The complete second set was sourced from the vault master reels for this release [5]
- **gd1977-12-29.aud.92374.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by unknown; source: n-th gen maxell cassette-> sb audigy-> audacity-> cd wav-> flac [6]. Also: The recording was made by an unknown individual within the listener's circle of friends [11]
